segmentos.en:
"Tlamatini, run the **WINDOW SPOTLIGHT** demo, please — a short, " "fully-visible showcase of the **Windower** agent (the desktop window " "manager) driven from chat through its wrapped **chat_agent_windower** tool. " "PRECONDITIONS: tick ONLY the **Multi-Turn** checkbox in the toolbar before " "sending (ACPX is NOT required — Windower is a standard Multi-Turn " "tool). This demo is Windows-only (Windower uses the Win32 API). " "\n\n" "Step 0: open with one HTML banner — " "
" "

🟫 WINDOW SPOTLIGHT 🟫

" "
Tlamatini Windower — bring a real window to the front and watch it grow
. " "\n\n" "Step 1: launch Notepad so there is a window to manage — call " "**chat_agent_executer** with script='notepad' and non_blocking=true, then " "confirm the window is up with **chat_agent_window_present** (window_title='Notepad'). " "\n\n" "Step 2: bring it to the foreground and maximize it so the user SEES it move " "— call **chat_agent_windower** with action='maximize' and " "window_title='Notepad' and activate_after=true. " "\n\n" "Step 3: read back the live window with **chat_agent_windower** action='list' " "and window_title='Notepad'. From the promoted result fields capture: matched, " "match_count, state, left, top, width, height. " "\n\n" "Step 4: render an HTML table with class='exec-report-table' titled " "'Window Operation' and two columns field / " "value, one row each for action, window_title, matched, state, left, " "top, width, height (the promoted INI_SECTION_WINDOWER fields). Keep every body " "cell light-background with dark text (background:#ffffff;color:#0f172a; or " "striped #f1f5f9). " "\n\n" "Step 5: clean up — close the window with **chat_agent_windower** " "action='close' and window_title='Notepad'. If a 'Save changes?' dialog appears, " "dismiss it WITHOUT saving via **chat_agent_keyboarder** input_sequence=\"alt+n\". " "\n\n" "Step 6: close with one HTML banner that reuses the Step 0 gradient and prints, " "in big white letters, 'WINDOW MANAGED ✓', and underneath a one-line " "metric 'state: · size: x · at " "(,)'. End with END-RESPONSE."

" "PRECONDICIONES: marca SÓLO la casilla **Multi-Turn** en la barra de herramientas antes de " "enviar (NO se necesita ACPX — Windower es un tool Multi-Turn " "estándar). Esta demo es sólo para Windows (Windower usa la API Win32). " "\n\n" "Paso 0: abre con un banner HTML — " "

🟫 VENTANA BAJO EL REFLECTOR 🟫

Tlamatini Windower — trae una ventana real al frente y mírala crecer
. " "\n\n" "Paso 1: abre Notepad para que haya una ventana que administrar — llama " "a **chat_agent_executer** con script='notepad' y non_blocking=true y luego " "confirma que la ventana está arriba con **chat_agent_window_present** (window_title='Notepad'). " "\n\n" "Paso 2: tráela al frente y maximízala para que el usuario VEA cómo se mueve " "— llama a **chat_agent_windower** con action='maximize' y " "window_title='Notepad' y activate_after=true. " "\n\n" "Paso 3: vuelve a leer la ventana en vivo con **chat_agent_windower** action='list' y " "window_title='Notepad'. De los campos promovidos del resultado, captura: matched, " "match_count, state, left, top, width, height. " "\n\n" "Paso 4: muestra una tabla HTML con class='exec-report-table' titulada " "'Operación de ventana' y dos columnas campo / " "valor, una fila para cada uno de action, window_title, matched, state, left, " "top, width, height (los campos promovidos de INI_SECTION_WINDOWER). Deja cada celda " "del cuerpo con fondo claro y texto oscuro (background:#ffffff;color:#0f172a; o " "rayado #f1f5f9). " "\n\n" "Paso 5: limpia — cierra la ventana con **chat_agent_windower** " "action='close' y window_title='Notepad'. Si aparece un diálogo 'Save changes?', " "descártalo SIN guardar con **chat_agent_keyboarder** input_sequence=\"alt+n\". " "\n\n" "Paso 6: cierra con un banner HTML que reutilice el gradiente del Paso 0 y muestre, en " "letras blancas grandes, 'VENTANA ADMINISTRADA ✓' y, debajo, una " "métrica de una línea 'estado: · tamaño: x · en " "(,)'. Termina con END-RESPONSE."

segmentos.en:
"Tlamatini, run the **WINDOW CHOREOGRAPHY** demo, please — a richer, " "fully-visible showcase that makes a single window dance around the screen " "using the **Windower** agent's tile / move / list verbs through its wrapped " "**chat_agent_windower** tool. " "PRECONDITIONS: tick ONLY the **Multi-Turn** checkbox before sending (ACPX is " "NOT required). Windows-only (Win32). Run each window operation as a SEPARATE " "chat_agent_windower call and pause briefly between them so the movement is " "visible. " "\n\n" "Step 0: open with one HTML banner — " "
" "

🟫 WINDOW CHOREOGRAPHY 🟫

" "
Tlamatini Windower — tile, snap and slide a live window
. " "\n\n" "Step 1: launch Notepad with **chat_agent_executer** script='notepad' and " "non_blocking=true, then confirm it with **chat_agent_window_present** " "(window_title='Notepad'). " "\n\n" "Step 2: perform this choreography, ONE chat_agent_windower call per move, each " "with window_title='Notepad' and activate_after=true, capturing the promoted " "state/left/top/width/height after each call: " "(a) action='restore'; " "(b) action='arrange' and arrange_mode='left' (snaps to the left half); " "(c) action='arrange' and arrange_mode='right' (snaps to the right half); " "(d) action='arrange' and arrange_mode='top-left' (top-left quadrant); " "(e) action='move_resize' and pos_x=220 and pos_y=160 and width=900 and " "height=600 (an explicit rectangle). " "\n\n" "Step 3: enumerate the whole desktop with **chat_agent_windower** action='list' " "(leave window_title empty) and capture match_count (the number of open windows). " "\n\n" "Step 4: render an HTML table with class='exec-report-table' titled " "'Window Choreography Trace' and columns step, " "action, mode / geometry, state, left, " "top, width, height — one row for each of the " "five moves (a)..(e) using that call's promoted fields. Keep every body cell " "light-background with dark text (background:#ffffff;color:#0f172a; or striped " "#f1f5f9). " "\n\n" "Step 5: clean up — **chat_agent_windower** action='close' and " "window_title='Notepad'; if a 'Save changes?' dialog appears, dismiss it WITHOUT " "saving via **chat_agent_keyboarder** input_sequence=\"alt+n\". " "\n\n" "Step 6: close with one HTML banner that reuses the Step 0 gradient and prints, " "in big white letters, 'CHOREOGRAPHY COMPLETE ✓', and underneath a " "one-line metric 'moves performed: 5 · open windows seen: " "· final size: x'. End with END-RESPONSE."

" "PRECONDICIONES: marca SÓLO la casilla **Multi-Turn** antes de enviar (ACPX " "NO es necesario). Sólo para Windows (Win32). Haz cada operación de ventana como una llamada " "SEPARADA a chat_agent_windower y haz una pausa breve entre ellas para que el movimiento " "sea visible. " "\n\n" "Paso 0: abre con un banner HTML — " "

🟫 COREOGRAFÍA DE VENTANAS " "🟫

Tlamatini Windower — acomoda, ajusta y desliza una ventana en vivo
. " "\n\n" "Paso 1: abre Notepad con **chat_agent_executer** script='notepad' " "y non_blocking=true y luego confírmalo con **chat_agent_window_present** " "(window_title='Notepad'). " "\n\n" "Paso 2: haz esta coreografía, UNA llamada a chat_agent_windower por movimiento, cada " "una con window_title='Notepad' y activate_after=true, y captura los campos promovidos " "state/left/top/width/height después de cada " "llamada: (a) action='restore'; " "(b) action='arrange' y arrange_mode='left' (se ajusta a la mitad izquierda); " "(c) action='arrange' y arrange_mode='right' (se ajusta a la mitad derecha); " "(d) action='arrange' y arrange_mode='top-left' (cuadrante superior izquierdo); " "(e) action='move_resize' y pos_x=220 y pos_y=160 y width=900 y height=600 " "(un rectángulo explícito). \n\nPaso " "3" ": enumera todo el escritorio con **chat_agent_windower** action='list' (deja " "window_title vacío) y captura match_count (el número de ventanas abiertas). \n\nPaso " "4" ": muestra una tabla HTML con class='exec-report-table' titulada " "'Rastro de la coreografía de ventanas' y con las columnas paso, " "action, modo / geometría, state, left, " "top, width, height — una fila por cada uno de los cinco " "movimientos (a)..(e) con los campos promovidos de esa llamada. Deja cada celda del cuerpo con " "fondo claro y texto oscuro (background:#ffffff;color:#0f172a; o rayado " "#f1f5f9). " "\n\n" "Paso 5: limpia — **chat_agent_windower** action='close' y " "window_title='Notepad'; si aparece un diálogo 'Save changes?', descártalo SIN guardar " "con **chat_agent_keyboarder** input_sequence=\"alt+n\". " "\n\n" "Paso 6: cierra con un banner HTML que reutilice el gradiente del Paso 0 y muestre, en " "letras blancas grandes, 'COREOGRAFÍA COMPLETA ✓' y, debajo, una " "métrica de una línea 'movimientos hechos: 5 · ventanas abiertas vistas: " "· tamaño final: x'. Termina con END-RESPONSE."

" "PRECONDITIONS: tick ONLY the **Multi-Turn** checkbox before sending (ACPX is " "NOT required). Playwright must be installed (`pip install playwright && " "playwright install`). The demo uses headless=false so you WATCH the browser " "open and drive itself, and hold_open_seconds=10 so it stays visible for 10 " "seconds before it closes. . " "\n\n" "Step 2: parse the run result and capture the promoted fields status, final_url, " "steps_run, assert_result, plus the extracted values 'heading' and 'intro' and " "the screenshot path. " "\n\n" "Step 3: render an HTML table with class='exec-report-table' titled " "'Browser Run' and two columns field / value, " "one row each for start_url, final_url, status, steps_run, assert_result, " "heading, screenshot path. Keep every body cell light-background with dark text " "(background:#ffffff;color:#0f172a; or striped #f1f5f9). " "\n\n" "Step 4: render the extracted intro paragraph inside an HTML " "
...intro...
. " "\n\n" "Step 5: close with one HTML banner that reuses the Step 0 gradient and prints, " "in big white letters, 'PAGE CAPTURED ✓' (if status is ok and " "assert_result is pass) or 'BROWSER RUN: ' otherwise, and underneath a " "one-line metric 'status: · assert: · " "steps: · shot: C:/Temp/example_spotlight.png'. End with " "END-RESPONSE."

"Tlamatini, run the **BROWSER WIZARD** demo, please — a richer, " "fully-visible showcase of the **Playwrighter** agent performing a multi-step " "interactive search on Wikipedia (type a query, click search, wait for the " "article, read it, assert and screenshot) through its wrapped " "**chat_agent_playwrighter** tool. " "PRECONDITIONS: tick ONLY the **Multi-Turn** checkbox before sending (ACPX is " "NOT required). Playwright must be installed (`pip install playwright && " "playwright install`). The demo uses headless=false so you WATCH the browser " "fill the form, click and navigate, and hold_open_seconds=10 so it stays " "visible for 10 seconds before it closes. " "\n\n" "Step 0: open with one HTML banner — " "
" "

🌐 BROWSER WIZARD 🌐

" "
Tlamatini Playwrighter — a real browser searches Wikipedia step by step
. " "\n\n" "Step 1: call **chat_agent_playwrighter** with start_url='https://www.wikipedia.org' " "and headless=false and hold_open_seconds=10 and steps_json='[{\"action\":\"fill\",\"selector\":\"#searchInput\",\"value\":\"Nahuatl\"}," "{\"action\":\"click\",\"selector\":\"button[type=submit]\"}," "{\"action\":\"wait_for\",\"selector\":\"#firstHeading\"}," "{\"action\":\"extract_text\",\"selector\":\"#firstHeading\",\"name\":\"article_title\"}," "{\"action\":\"extract_text\",\"selector\":\"#mw-content-text p\",\"name\":\"first_paragraph\"}," "{\"action\":\"assert_text\",\"selector\":\"#firstHeading\",\"contains\":\"Nahuatl\"}," "{\"action\":\"screenshot\",\"path\":\"C:/Temp/wikipedia_wizard.png\",\"full_page\":false}]'. " "\n\n" "Step 2: parse the run result and capture the promoted fields status, final_url, " "steps_run, assert_result, plus the extracted values 'article_title' and " "'first_paragraph' and the screenshot path. " "\n\n" "Step 3: render a STEP SCOREBOARD — a row of three HTML chips of the form " "LABEL: a 'status: " "' chip (CHIP_BG #16a34a when ok, else #dc2626), an 'assert: " "' chip (CHIP_BG #16a34a when pass, else #dc2626), and a 'steps: " "' chip (CHIP_BG #2563EB). " "\n\n" "Step 4: render an HTML table with class='exec-report-table' titled " "'Browser Wizard Result' and two columns field / " "value, one row each for start_url, final_url, status, steps_run, " "assert_result, article_title, screenshot path. Keep every body cell " "light-background with dark text (background:#ffffff;color:#0f172a; or striped " "#f1f5f9). " "\n\n" "Step 5: render the extracted first_paragraph inside an HTML " "
...first_paragraph...

End with END-RESPONSE."
